nameEn: Repair of electronic and optical equipment
description: This class includes the repair and maintenance of electronic and optical equipment used in industry.
includes: repair and maintenance of industrial process control equipment
repair and maintenance of measuring, testing, navigating and control equipment (industrial)
repair and maintenance of irradiation, electromedical and electrotherapeutic equipment
repair and maintenance of optical instruments and equipment: microscopes, telescopes, prisms, lenses
repair and maintenance of photographic equipment
repair of radar and navigation equipment
excludes: repair of computers and peripheral equipment, see 9511
repair of consumer electronics (TV, radio), see 9521
repair of cameras and optical instruments for personal use, see 9529
